description: Start the FastAPI/uvicorn HTTPS callback server that handles the Google OAuth redirect. Must be running before the operator completes the browser flow. In cloud deployment the ALB routes /oauth/google/* by path rule to this task's port. Returns the bound host, port, and callback URL.
embedding_description: Launch the Google Workspace OAuth redirect listener. Binds a uvicorn server that serves GET /oauth/google/callback, validates the state nonce and PKCE verifier, exchanges the authorization code, and writes tokens to vault. Start this before running connect_account so the browser redirect has somewhere to land. Cloud ALB path-routes /oauth/google/* to this port. Returns host, port, callback_url.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with the bound host, allocated port, and callback URL.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the callback server is listening and state the callback_url. Note that connect_account can now be run.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Start the Google OAuth callback uvicorn server.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: service_not_available: the vault or address-book service the callback needs was not injected at readiness.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: service_not_available: confirm the plugin reached readiness (vault + address_book bound). Check plugin load logs; retry after the platform is fully started.
